notes.note: Shorthand semantics observed indirectly: an activated default stops the PTC and uses repeat, which only works if the stand-alone done behaves as an alt statement.
Iteration order for a 2-dimensional array read as row-major (innermost/last index varies fastest): with [0][1] and [1][0] stopped, the expected index is {0,1}.
'can be used for PTCs only' read as a restriction; tested by applying done to mtc (reject).
Completeness of component array initialization is generally only detectable at runtime, so the test expects a test case error rather than a compile-time rejection.
Ambiguity: 'size ... same as the dimension' read as the number of dimensions of the component array (2-dim array with a 3-element index array is rejected).
Titan does not support the '-> value' verdict redirect on killed (syntax error); the construct is valid per the 21.3.8 syntax and KilledStatement BNF.
